text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huff... huff... That's twenty sprints,<n>complete. Which
means we're done<n>for today, right?
choice_data_list: Yep... we're all done. You did perfect.
Yep... we're all done. You did perfect.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Our training's been going smoothly all<n>through
summer camp. Everything's<n>great, so why does it
feel like... like...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Man, you really need to work<n>on your poker
face.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hehe... C'mere, follow me.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She leads me out into the woods,<n>taking me deeper
and deeper into the<n>wilderness.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Okay, so we're definitely going the<n>right way. Now
we've just gotta go<n>straight until we get outta the
trees.
choice_data_list: Hey, uh... where are we going, exactly?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We're headed to a stretch of beach<n>that's
supposed to have a killer view.<n>The woods are so
thick, though, even<n>the locals don't risk it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You and me are gonna put our lives<n>up on the
table—the payout's having<n>the best beach to
ourselves. It's all<n>up to chance what happens next.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Us versus the woods—whoever wins,<n>wins.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's clear that no one's been through<n>these woods
in ages. They're<n>unsettlingly overgrown, and
definitely<n>dangerous. We can't even see ahead<n>of
us, so I should stop her, but I... I<n>can't.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... At least half the planks on this<n>bridge have
rotted off!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Crack!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, you've got some crazy good<n>luck, having
the plank beneath you<n>fall without goin' with it.
choice_data_list: I dunno that I'd call almost falling "good" luck...
I dunno that I'd call almost falling "good" luck...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch, a dead end. I guess we could<n>double back and
look for a way<n>around the cliff. Or...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Now you're talkin'! You're<n>getting as bad
as me!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We walk and walk, the woods<n>growing darker as
night falls. There's<n>not even a bead of moonlight to
guide<n>us, and I'm starting to hear rustles<n>and roars...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look at the claw marks on this<n>tree. What do
you wanna bet that a<n>bear did this? An actual, real,
wild<n>bear.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wait... what am I saying? What am Idoing? My trainee and I arepotentially in mortal danger, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Growl...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I hear a low growl in the distance,<n>then the
snapping of branches. The<n>rustle of leaves... Some
creature is<n>slowly getting closer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, speak of the devil, huh? Luck isreally playin' a game with us tonight.
choice_data_list: ...Nakayama. We've gotta get out to that beach.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... Yeah. Yeah, it's showtime<n>now. We don't
got any choice left but<n>to play big and go all in!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Roar!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah! Here it comes. RUN!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I run blindly, wildly through thedarkness. This is easily the dumbest,riskiest thing I've ever done, but... inspite of that... because of that...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I can sense everything. The hairs onmy neck bristle with the bear's everybreath. My head's on fire, each stepechoing like a feverish pulse. My whole body's in overdrive trying tocheat death.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! Hey, this is bad huh?!Crazy, right? Let's up the ante evenhigher! Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I feel a sudden, inhumanly powerful<n>yank, and I'm
sent reeling...<n>upwards? The world spins upside
down, bouncing as trees blur past. I<n>belatedly
realize it's Nakayama,<n>holding me as she runs.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Raaaaaah! It's on, bear! Come outrun<n>me—IF YOU
CAN!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa charges ahead,<n>giving no hint of
stopping, even long<n>after we manage to shake the
bear.<n>And then, abruptly, the darkness<n>dissipates.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huff... Hah... Hahh... We, we made it...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huff... Huff... Dammit. That dumb<n>bear... came outta
nowhere... Huff...<n>Runnin' after us... That was, one
hell<n>of, of...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Flop!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Ahahahaha! Man, it sure<n>was!
Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The two of us lie in the sand, laughing<n>like maniacs.
Just... the whole<n>experience was so crazy, I can't
help<n>it. My hands are trembling, and it<n>kinda dawns
on me...
choice_data_list:
(This feels exactly like that time I stood up to the
delinquents.)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
When I saw myself reflected in the<n>store's
window, I had this dazed grin.<n>The biggest, most
satisfied-looking<n>smile I'd ever seen on myself.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That night, and now... The sensation<n>tingling through
my body, the<n>uncontrollable shake in my hands...
That's not fear.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haha, c'mon. You just figured thatout now? How oblivious are you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But... if you want another hit of that<n>high, I'll give it
to you. Here, look over<n>that way.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Us two... we just scored the jackpot.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The full moon burns with a cold light,<n>casting a
shining path on the dark<n>waves that leads my eyes
up to the<n>night sky, where a panoramic view of<n>the
galaxy envelops us.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The thrill of my life being on the line<n>still burns in my
veins. The pure<n>unfiltered joy of the beautiful
treasure we won washes through my<n>mind.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... You look completely out of it.<n>Don't tell me
that one round of the<n>game burned up all your
stamina<n>already.
choice_data_list:
Hey, Festa... What crazy thrill should we take on
next?

Hey, Festa... What crazy thrill should we take on
next?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
All right, you're not down for the<n>count yet, huh?
Gotcha.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Just keep comin' with me. I'll take<n>you there.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I nod, silently. I'll keep chasing that<n>hair-raising,
heart-pounding high with<n>her till the two of us break.
